d:
Sadaiv mangal karne vali shri hanuman chalisa ka shravan karen Shivay Vyas ke svaron men Shree Hanuman Chalisa - Hanuman Ashtak shri hanuman ji ki puja aaradhna men hanuman ji ki chalisa ka path bahut hi pramukh mana jata hai I
The Hanuman Chalisa is a Hindu devotional hymn in praise of Hanuman. It was authored by Tulsidas in the Awadhi language, and is his best-known text apart from the Ramcharitmanas.
. shri hanuman chalisa .
. doha.
Shriguru charan saroj raj
Nij manu mukuru sudhari .
Barnaun raghubar bimal jasu
Jo dayku phal chari .
